sources.title: SOURCE: Redigo.info — Verbale integrativo sottoscritto il 25 novembre 2024 (accordo siglato 18 novembre 2024). Salary tables for aziende artigiane (Art. 33): 8 tranches starting Dec 2024. All 8 level values confirmed. Level 1A total includes indennita di funzione 51.65 EUR.

SOURCE: Kitech.it — CNEL code G016 confirmed. Mar 2026 salary table cross-validated: 1A base 2490.07 + indennita funzione 51.65 = 2541.72 total. Hourly divisor 173 confirmed. Seniority amounts per level confirmed: 1A=16.01, 1B=16.01, 2=14.20, 3=13.43, 4=12.65, 5bis=11.88, 5=11.36, 6=10.33. Cadence 24m, max 5 scatti.

SOURCE: Lavoro-Economia.it — Aggregator showing CCNL text. Per-level seniority amounts independently match kitech.it: 1A=16.01, 1B=16.01, 2=14.20, 3=13.43, 4=12.65, 5bis=11.88, 5=11.36, 6=10.33. Hourly divisor 173 confirmed (40h/week table). Page reflects pre-2024 CCNL base text; amounts not changed by 2024 rinnovo. NOTE: aggregator source, not verified against CCNL PDF.

SOURCE: ADAPT Farecontrattazione.it — Academic analysis of the Nov 2024 rinnovo. Confirms: aziende artigiane total increase EUR 200 over 4 tranches (Dec 2024, Jul 2025, Mar 2026, Nov 2026). Apprenticeship new rules: operai/tecnici 5 years max, amministrativi 3 years, centraliniste 2 years. Apprentice seniority accrual improved in rinnovo. CNEL G016, INPS ARTIGIANATO sector.

notes.text: SALARY MODEL: conglobated (minimi tabellari conglobati). Confirmed: ilccnl.it shows contingenza=0.00 for all levels. Back-calculation at Jul 2025: livello 4=1763.56/173=10.194 EUR/h, livello 1B=2160.15/173=12.487 EUR/h, livello 6=1452.42/173=8.394 EUR/h — all values divide to proportional hourly rates consistent with divisor 173, confirming conglobated model.
CNEL CODE: G016 confirmed from kitech.it and ADAPT farecontrattazione.it.
TRANCHE DATES: four tranches — 2024-12-01 (from Nov 2024 verbale integrativo), 2025-07-01, 2026-03-01, 2026-11-01. Source: redigo.info. Cross-validated Mar 2026 values against kitech.it.
HOURLY DIVISOR: 173. Source: ilccnl.it explicit '173.00 ore'. Cross-validated via back-calculation across 3 levels (see conglobated check above).
ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 13 (tredicesima only). Source: ilccnl.it ('una mensilita globale di fatto'). No quattordicesima.

SENIORITY: biennale (every 24 months), maximum 5 scatti. Per-level EUR amounts from two independent aggregators (kitech.it, lavoro-economia.it): 1A=16.01, 1B=16.01, 2=14.20, 3=13.43, 4=12.65, 5bis=11.88, 5=11.36, 6=10.33. Cadence confirmed '5 aumenti biennali' from lavoro-economia.it. SIMPLIFICATION: primary source (CCNL PDF or official signatory site) not fetched; amounts not disputed by the 2024 rinnovo analysis (informaimpresa.it mentions only the NEW EUR 10 apprentice scatto, not a change to permanent scatti).

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: EUR 10.00 from 2025-01-01. New clause introduced by Nov 2024 rinnovo ('Migliorata la norma relativa agli apprendisti che andranno a maturare gli scatti di anzianita'). Amount EUR 10.00 from CNA Ancona official communication. Zero before Jan 2025.

LEVEL 1A FUNCTION ALLOWANCE: indennita di funzione EUR 51.65, confirmed kitech.it Mar 2026 (base 2490.07 + allowance 51.65 = total 2541.72). Assumed constant from Dec 2024; no primary source shows a change in this amount through the 2024 rinnovo.

LEVEL ORDERING: 6 (lowest) < 5 < 5bis < 4 < 3 < 2 < 1B < 1A (highest). Level 5bis has higher salary than level 5 — this is correct per the CCNL (5bis = specializzato BIS, above the basic specializzato).

APPRENTICESHIP PERCENTAGES (Art. 36 c. 6-7, signed renewal of 18 November 2024, CNA, PDF pp. 7-9, read on the page images), on the retribuzione tabellare of the destination level: 1st group (levels 3, 2, 1B, 1A) and 2nd group (4, 5bis), 5 years, 60, 60, 70, 70, 85, 85, 90, 90, 100, 100% by semester; the 5bis figures of 3 years ('sbobinatura [...] con l'interpretazione dei contenuti, correzione bozze, battitura testi') 60, 60, 75, 75, 90, 90%; 3rd group (level 5), 4 years, 60, 60, 70, 70, 90, 90, 100, 100%; the level 5 figures of 2 years 60, 80, 85, 95%; impiegati amministrativi of every level, 3 years, 60, 60, 70, 70, 90, 90%. These are the tracks of the file; the PMI tracks are those of Parte II art. 3 (p. 20).
INPS: reuses 2026-artigianato.json (ARTIGIANATO sector).

Only aziende artigiane salary tables modelled. PMI non-artigiane tables (Art. 4, with EUR 207 total increase vs EUR 200 for artigiane, difference of EUR 7 in the Nov 2026 tranche) are not modelled. Applies to a small minority of firms covered by this CCNL.

limitation.remediation: Add the Art. 4 PMI non-artigiane salary tables and a request field to select them.

notes.text: APPRENTICESHIP COHORT: 'Le nuove percentuali retributive previste nell'art. 36 [...] trovano applicazione solo per i lavoratori assunti a far data dalla sottoscrizione dell'Accordo di rinnovo del 16 maggio 2022. Per tutti gli altri lavoratori continuano a trovare applicazione le previgenti percentuali retributive' (dichiarazione a verbale, renewal of 18 November 2024, p. 12). The file models the current percentages only; an apprentice hired before 16 May 2022 is paid on them, not on the previous tables.

limitation.remediation: Source the percentage tables in force before 16 May 2022 and gate them on the hire date.

notes.text: APPRENTICESHIP (art. 36 Parte I, art. 3 Parte II, renewal 18 November 2024): each row of the table is a track (artigiane groups 1-3 with their 'figure a 2/3 anni', impiegati amministrativi, PMI); the caller picks the track with Apprentice.track where a level has several. The last percentage of each track holds past its semesters on purpose: art. 6-bis prolongs the apprenticeship by every suspension of at least 30 days and counts the suspension towards the pay progression (renewal p. 8), so an apprentice may be past the table; the caller ends the apprenticeship (Apprentice) at its end. Level 6 is not apprenticeable.

Both apprenticeship tracks (operai_tecnici and amministrativi) are assigned to all 8 destination levels. In practice, the CCNL differentiates by job role, not only by destination level. Firms must select the correct track by role type.
LEVEL CATEGORY: all levels left null. Multiple levels map to both operai and impiegati roles — a genuine one-to-many mapping the schema cannot represent as a single category value.

limitation.remediation: Declare the worker category in the request; the levels map to both operai and impiegati.

notes.text: FUNCTION ALLOWANCE (art. 71: 'al personale con qualifica di quadro sarà riconosciuta una indennità di funzione di euro 51,65'): the nota a verbale of 15 July 2026 (CNA, p. 2) reads it as 'distinto dai minimi contrattuali [...] non è pertanto ricompresa nell'importo indicato nelle tabelle retributive per il livello 1A', to be shown 'con voce autonoma e distinta' from 1 August 2026, and 'nulla è dovuto a titolo di arretrati o conguagli' for the earlier periods. The file pays it on level 1A from 1 August 2026, nothing before.

Art. 71: the allowance absorbs the individual superminimo 'fino a concorrenza del 50% di tale importo' (at most 25,83). The engine pays it whole: its absorption (absorbed_by_individual_excess) offsets the whole allowance, not half of it.

limitation.remediation: Absorb the individual superminimo into the art. 71 allowance up to half of its amount.

notes.text: INPS RATES: the employer and worker INPS rates of the sector (artigianato) are totals no 2026 INPS or association table confirms: the only component split found is the INPS guide of 2012 and the 2026 totals come from a software house page that does not prove its year. The contributions of every run rest on them.

limitation.remediation: Source the artigianato rates of 2026 on an INPS or association table, mark the inps block of contribution/2026/artigianato.json derived, then remove this note.

notes.text: APPRENTICE INPS RATES: the apprentice rates of the sector (artigianato) apply the 10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus the 1.61% NASpI, but no source found settles whether the 0.91 NASpI reduction of the artisan employers also applies to apprentices, nor the wage-integration contribution they owe (the FSBA is paid outside INPS). The contributions of an apprentice may differ.

limitation.remediation: Source the apprentice rates of artigianato (an INPS circular or an association table of 2026), mark the apprentice block of contribution/2026/artigianato.json derived, then remove this note.

provenance.transformation: Art. 3 c. 1 (from 1 January 2023): 0.60% of the INPS taxable pay up to 15 employees, 1.00% above, three quarters employer and one quarter worker; art. 1: employers of the artigianato (CSC 4, code 7B) are bound to FSBA, so every employee of the CCNL is charged, fixed terms included. Art. 3 c. 3 measures the headcount on the previous semester: the engine uses the employer headcount of the run. The additional 4% on the pay lost to ACIGS is not modelled.

reviews.scope: Monthly values on scanned pages, each read twice from the page image by two independent sessions of another model, the second without being told the expected value.
findings: 28 values read identically by both readings and equal to the file.

reviews.scope: FSBA ordinary contribution, art. 3 of the 2024 regulation, read on the text layer (analysis by a separate model session).
findings: Added parameters.solidarity_fund FSBA: 0.45%+0.15% up to 15 employees, 0.75%+0.25% above, on the INPS base, fixed terms included.

reviews.scope: Apprenticeship tracks against art. 36 and art. 3 Parte II of the signed 2024 renewal, read on the page images (pp. 7-9, 20).
findings: The file had two generic tracks (operai_tecnici 70-100% over four years, amministrativi 70/80/90%) and level 6 as a destination; the text prints one row per group, figures and PMI: impiegati amministrativi are 60/70/90%, so the file overpaid the first two years by 10 points.

Tracks replaced: operai_tecnici, amministrativi -> artigiane_gruppo_1, artigiane_gruppo_2, artigiane_gruppo_2_figure_3_anni, artigiane_gruppo_3, artigiane_gruppo_3_figure_2_anni, impiegati_amministrativi, pmi, pmi_figure_2_anni.

reviews.scope: Art. 36 c. 6-7 and the dichiarazione a verbale on the percentages, signed renewal of 18 November 2024, PDF pp. 7-9 and 12.
findings: Read the percentage tables on the page images: every artisan track of the file matches the signed table, so the note claiming percentages assumed from the CCNA framework was stale; closed apprenticeship_percentages_assumed. The new percentages apply to hires from 16 May 2022, not from 18 November 2024: corrected the cohort limitation.

reviews.scope: Art. 71 function allowance of the quadri and the nota a verbale of 15 July 2026.
findings: Read the nota a verbale on the page image: the allowance is separate from the 1A minimum from 1 August 2026 and nothing is due before. The file added it to the 1A minimum from December 2024; set it to zero until 31 July 2026, closed function_allowance_constant and recorded the 50% superminimo absorption of art. 71, which the engine cannot express.
